'''Snowshine''' is a 5★ [[Cryo]] [[Defender]] [[Operator]] from [[Rhodes Island]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''. She is a [[Great Sword]] user who can protect teammates by retaliating enemy attacks, provide HP treatment to injured teammates, and cast ultimates that can apply {{G|Solidification|Solidification}} to the enemy.

==Profile==
"Wind speed's okay. Visibility's good. Perfect weather for snowboarding."<br/>Snowshine is a [[Rhodes Island]] operator assigned to [[Endfield Industries]] where she serves as a search and rescue (SAR) professional under the framework agreement between the two companies.<br/>For well-known reasons, the true polar regions of [[Talos-II]] remain off-limits to humanity. However, as frontier expansion resumes, professionals like Snowshine who specialize in the geography of polar and high-altitude regions are in growing demand within the [[Civilization Band]].<br/>Because of the significant talent gap, Snowshine and her rescue team are always faced with a busy schedule, even on days with no special missions.<br/>"I like the snow, the white-capped mountains, and the shimmering beauty revealed only in the frigid cold... This is why I don't want them to leave painful memories to the people they touch."
